blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits—substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.
blocks.zh: Jev风格的决定模型在不生成自由格式文本的情况下,在预定义选项上返回绝对概率分布,使软件系统能够直接对其输出采取行动. 在这项工作中,我们调查通用有限责任公司在多大程度上已经具备这种能力,以及何时实际需要微调。 我们介绍LLM2Jev,这是一个架构保存框架,它直接从括号内的数字识别符上的下位概率中提取校正决定。 LLM2Jev 既提供了无训练推论食谱,又提供了微调目标,通过树构型列表损失优化候选人选择,同时利用KL差分罚则将辅助预测锁定到基模型. 在Quen3.5-4B和Quen3-0.6B上评价后,我们发现现代的LLMs是内在有效的决策模型:没有培训,4B模型与基于同一主干线的社区Jev风格的模型匹配,表现优于字母-logit读取,支持任意选项计数,本土处理多模式决定相对于图像. 微调可提供目标明确的而不是普遍的效益——大大改进较弱的模式和具体的任务(例如许多选择的意图路线),但为强大的骨干提供较低的回报。 关键的是,我们的KL主播在对话文本生成中防止行为退化,LORA在有能力的模型上提供最强的性能.

blocks.en: Software systems routinely make decisions over predefined options: routing a support ticket, identifying a user’s intent, or verifying whether evidence satisfies a given rule. While standard chat models can perform these tasks, their generated responses must be parsed into structured values, introducing latency and the risk of malformed outputs. Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) addresses this by directly returning a probability distribution across candidate options without free-form text generation, allowing downstream software to consume its predictions natively. Jev aims to be fast and cost-effective while retaining the broad versatility of an LLM: deploying a new task requires only an instruction prompt and a set of candidate options rather than a dedicated classifier. This paradigm has attracted considerable attention; although Jev’s model weights and training methodologies remain proprietary, the public JevBench leaderboard ( Benchmark Heaven, 2026 ) already lists over 60 community Jev-style models.
blocks.zh: 软件系统通常就预先界定的选项作出决定:确定支持票的路由、确定用户的意图,或核实证据是否符合某一规则。 虽然标准聊天模式可以完成这些任务,但其生成的响应必须被解析成结构化的值,引入延迟性和输出错误的风险. Jev(Almeida,2026年)通过在不自由格式文本生成的情况下直接返回候选选项之间的概率分布来解决这个问题,允许下游软件在本土上消费其预测. Jev的目标是迅速和具有成本效益,同时保留LLM的广泛多功能性:部署新任务只需要指示即时和一套候选选项,而不是专门的分类器. 虽然Jev的模型权重和训练方法仍然是专有的, 但公共的Jev Bench领导板(Basic Heaven, 2026)已经列出超过60个社区Jev风格的模型。

blocks.en: A central design choice among these community Jev-style models is whether to update model parameters. Many approaches fine-tune the backbone, frequently introducing custom classification heads or LoRA adapters trained on synthetic questions from teacher models; others evaluate frozen LLMs directly. The resulting performances vary substantially. For instance, Plumb ( crh225, 2026 ) fine-tunes Qwen3.5-4B with LoRA over several iterative rounds of teacher-generated queries and hard-negative mining, achieving 89.6% accuracy on public JevBench items. In contrast, Hopper ( HopitAI, 2026 ) and reflex ( kshetrajna12, 2026 ) , both similarly adapted from Qwen3.5-4B, yield performance comparable to SemIf ( Lee, 2026 ) , which simply extracts option-letter logits from the unmodified frozen model (82.3% and 79.2% vs. 81.0%). This stark contrast raises two fundamental questions: to what extent do pre-trained LLMs inherently possess decision-making capabilities, and under what conditions does fine-tuning yield practical gains?
blocks.zh: 在这些社区中选择中央设计 Jev风格的模型是是否更新模型参数. 许多方法对骨干进行微调,经常引入自定义分类头或LORA适配器,从教师模型中接受合成问题培训;其他方法则直接评价冷冻LLMS. 由此产生的表现大不相同。 例如,Plumb(crh225,2026年)在几轮教师生成的查询和硬负式开采中与LORA进行了Quen3.5-4B的微调,在公开的Jev Bench项目上实现了89.6%的准确度. 相比之下,Hopper(HopitAI, 2026年)和反射(khashetrajna12, 2026年)均从Quen3.5-4B中类似改编,产生与SemIf(Lee, 2026年)相似的性能,仅从未修改的冷冻模型中提取了选项字母对数(82.3%,79.2%对81.0%). 这种鲜明的对比提出了两个基本问题:经过预先培训的有限责任方案在何种程度上具有决策能力,以及在什么条件下微调能产生实际收益?

blocks.en: We present a framework that turns existing causal LLMs into Jev-style decision models without altering their architectures, tokenizers, or vocabularies, while minimizing dependence on task-specific training. In contrast to many community Jev-style models that introduce custom classification or pointer heads ( Palmer, 2026 ; mohit67890, 2026 ; FlyMy.AI, 2026 ; Cai, 2026 ; akhilaaa3, 2026 ; Gribov, 2026 ) or reserved tokens ( Palmer, 2026 ; FlyMy.AI, 2026 ) —which must be retrained for every new backbone—our architecture-preserving design provides three distinct benefits: • Zero architectural overhead per backbone. The same prompting convention and parallel scoring procedure apply out of the box to any causal LLM, allowing newly released models to be evaluated immediately and fine-tuned only when targeted adaptation is required. • Direct inheritance of base model scaling. As foundation models advance in general reasoning and factual knowledge, their decision-making accuracy improves correspondingly without necessitating new decision-specific training corpora. • Native multimodal support. Multimodal LLMs equipped with vision encoders can perform image classification and visual question answering through the identical interface without multimodal fine-tuning (§ 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,将现有的因果有限责任公司转变为Jev式决策模式,而不改变其架构、标语或词汇,同时尽量减少对具体任务培训的依赖。 与许多采用定制分类或指头(帕尔默,2026年;mohit67890,2026年;FlyMy.AI,2026年;Cai,2026年;akhilaaa3,2026年;Gribov,2026年)或保留标志(帕尔默,2026年;FlyMy.AI,2026年)的Jev风格模型形成对比,这些模型必须重新训练每个新的骨干——我们的建筑保护设计提供了三个截然不同的好处: •每个骨干零建筑间接费用. 同样的催化公约和平行评分程序适用于任何因果的LLM,只允许在需要有针对性的适应时立即评估新发布的模型并进行微调。 • 直接继承基准模型规模。 随着基础模型在一般推理和事实知识方面的进步,其决策准确性相应提高,而不必进行新的针对具体决策的培训。 • 当地多式联运支助。 配备了视觉编码器的多式联运LLMs可以通过相同的接口进行图像分类和视觉问答,而无需对多式联运进行微调(§4.2).

blocks.en: LLM2Jev introduces two recipes unified under a single interface (Figure 1 ). The training-free recipe formats candidate options with bracketed numeric indices [1] … [K] , conditions generation on the assistant prefix Best answer: [ , and computes joint probabilities over candidate continuation tokens; it requires no labeled supervision, additional parameters, or vocabulary expansions. The fine-tuning recipe operates through the identical interface, updating either full model weights or LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) : a tree-factorized listwise loss trains the model to discriminate among valid candidates, while three auxiliary KL-divergence penalties ( anchors ) prevent probability drift across other generation contexts. Under either configuration, the model remains a fully functional causal LLM capable of standard text generation.
blocks.zh: LLM2Jev引入了在单一界面下统一的两个食谱(图1). 无培训食谱格式的候选选项,括号内的数字指数 [1]. [K],助手前缀上的条件生成 最佳答案:[,并计算候选人续作符号的连带概率;它不需要标签监督,附加参数,或词汇扩展. 微调配方通过相同的界面运行,更新了完整的模型权重或LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年) :一个树因子化的列表式丢失训练模型对有效候选人进行区分,而三个辅助的KL-潜水处罚(锚)防止概率漂移到其他世代背景. 在任一配置下,该模型仍然是完全功能性的因果LLM,能够标准文本生成.

blocks.en: We evaluate both recipes on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B across six data compositions alongside ablations over anchor strengths and parameter-efficient tuning. Our evaluations span standard external benchmarks, the public JevBench suite, general linguistic capabilities, multimodal image benchmarks, and conversational behavior. Our findings resolve three core questions: 1. How capable are LLMs without fine-tuning? (§ 4.2 ) Substantially capable: a pre-trained LLM is inherently an effective decision model. Off-the-shelf Qwen3.5-4B matches competitive community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit extraction, naturally scales to arbitrary candidate counts, and exhibits strong probabilistic calibration. Furthermore, multimodal visual decision-making emerges zero-shot through the same interface. 2. When does fine-tuning help? (§ 4.3 ) Fine-tuning is primarily beneficial when training data directly covers specific deficiencies of the base model. It yields marked improvements for smaller models and targeted domains (such as high-cardinality intent routing), but provides diminishing returns—and can even induce negative transfer—when applied indiscriminately to capable models on broad benchmarks. Importantly, this targeted adaptation incurs negligible degradation in general model abilities. 3. How should one fine-tune? (§ 4.4 ) KL anchors are crucial for preventing degenerate generation outputs and preserving conversational integrity. Stronger models benefit most from LoRA paired with tight anchor constraints, whereas smaller models perform better with milder regularization.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在Quen3.5-4B和Quen3-0.6B上对六个数据构成的配方,同时对主锚强度和参数效率调节进行推敲。 我们的评价跨越了标准的外部基准、公共的Jev Bench套间、一般语言能力、多模式图像基准和对话行为。 我们的调查结果解决了三个核心问题: 1. 不进行微调的有限责任公司的能力如何? (§4.2) 相当有能力:经过预先培训的LLM本质上是有效的决策模式。 现成的 Quen3.5-4B 匹配有竞争力的社区 Jev风格的模型建在同一个主干上,表现优于字母-日志提取,自然尺度为任意候选人计数,并表现出强烈的概率校准. 此外,多式联运视觉决策通过同一界面出现零镜头。 2. 微调何时有所帮助? (§4.3) 在培训数据直接涵盖基准模型的具体缺陷时,微调主要是有益的。 它明显改善了较小的模型和有针对性的领域(如高心率意图路径),但如果不加区别地应用于关于广泛基准的有能力模型,则回报会减少,甚至会导致负转移。 重要的是,这种有针对性的适应在一般模型能力中可以忽略不计。 3. 如何进行微调? (§4.4) KL锚对防止退化的生成产出和维护对话完整性至关重要。 较强的模型从LORA得到的好处最大,同时对锚的制约很紧,而较小的模型在较温和的正规化的情况下表现较好。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: Jev formalizes decision tasks as categorical distributions over discrete candidate sets across three canonical formats ( Almeida, 2026 ) : choice (selecting one of K K options), noul (binary verification, “yes” vs. “no”), and score (ordinal grading). JevBench ( Benchmark Heaven, 2026 ) benchmarks such decision models across intelligence, calibration, inference latency, and computational cost. The benchmark provides 231 publicly released items (48 easy, 72 standard, and 111 hard), while held-out and sealed test suites remain private. In this study, we evaluate exclusively on the public items and therefore report diagnostic accuracies rather than official leaderboard standings.
blocks.zh: Jev将决定任务正式化,作为在离散候选人中间的绝对分布,分布在三种划线格式(Almeida, 2026年):选择(选择一个K选项)、nul(二进制核查,“是”对“否”)和得分(普通分)。 Jev Bench(基准天堂,2026年)将这种决策模型的基准跨过智能,校准,推论延迟和计算成本. 该基准提供231个公开发布的项目(48个容易,72个标准,111个硬),而被扣留和密封的测试套件仍然是私人的. 在这项研究中,我们只评估公共项目,因此报告诊断性急速性,而不是官方的领导地位。

blocks.en: Table 15 (Appendix I ) summarizes community Jev-style models closely related to our work. Frozen-model readouts extract predictions directly from output token probabilities without updating model parameters. For instance, SemIf ( Lee, 2026 ) and open-alternative-jev ( IkerMoel, 2026 ) read option-letter logits from an unmodified Qwen3.5-4B backbone, whereas Cygnet ( blockbrain-ai, 2026 ) and jqv ( Octalab, 2026 ) apply fitted temperatures to larger language models. AnyJev ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) mitigates option-order and prior biases via cyclic permutations and batch-level calibration.
blocks.zh: 表15(附录一)概述了与我们的工作密切相关的社区Jev型模式。 冷冻模型读取直接从输出符概率中提取预测,而不更新模型参数. 例如,SemIf(Lee, 2026年)和open-Protocol-jev(IkerMoel, 2026年)读取一个未经修改的Quen3.5-4B主干线的选项字母对数,而Cygnet(blackbrain-ai, 2026年)和jqv(Octalab, 2026年)则对更大的语言模型适用适当的温度。 AnyJev(Zhang等人,2026年)通过循环穿透和批量级校准减轻选择顺序和先前的偏差.

blocks.en: Fine-tuned readouts adapt model parameters to improve task-specific alignment. JevK5 ( allebee, 2026 ) , Plumb ( crh225, 2026 ) , Hopper ( HopitAI, 2026 ) , and reflex ( kshetrajna12, 2026 ) train LoRA adapters on Qwen3.5-4B; in particular, JevK5 and Plumb train on letter logits using challenging synthetic queries generated and filtered by teacher models alongside replay of public datasets. Among existing systems, decider ( Mapika, 2026 ) is conceptually closest to our regularization strategy: it performs full-parameter fine-tuning on a base model while encouraging predictions on replayed examples to match the parent model’s answer distribution.
blocks.zh: 精细校对调整模型参数,以改善任务特定对齐. JevK5(Allebee,2026年),Plumb(ch225,2026年),Hopper(HopitAI,2026年),以及反射(kshetrajna12,2026年)在Qune3.5-4B上列车LORA适配器;特别是JevK5和Plumb列车在字母对数上使用挑战性的合成查询,由教师模型在重播公共数据集的同时生成并过滤. 在现有的系统中,决定者(Mapika, 2026年)在概念上最接近我们的规范化战略:它在一个基本模型上进行全参数的微调,同时鼓励对重播的例子进行预测,以配合母模型的答案分布.

blocks.en: In automated decision-making systems, predicted probabilities are as critical as the top-1 choices themselves, enabling downstream logic to defer low-confidence cases to human review. Because modern neural networks and pre-trained LLMs frequently suffer from overconfidence ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Desai and Durrett, 2020 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ) , rigorous calibration assessment is essential. We report two standard metrics computed directly from raw model distributions without post-hoc temperature scaling: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and the Brier score. ECE quantifies the alignment between confidence and empirical accuracy by partitioning predictions into probability bins and computing the bin-weighted absolute discrepancy between average confidence and accuracy. The Brier score measures the mean squared error between the predicted probability vector and the one-hot target, simultaneously rewarding accuracy and probabilistic calibration. For both metrics, lower values indicate superior performance.
blocks.zh: 在自动决策系统中,预测的概率与顶级-1自行选择一样关键,使下游逻辑能够将低信心案件交由人类审查. 由于现代神经网络和经过预训的LLMs经常出现过度自信(Guo等人,2017年;Desai和Durrett,2020年;Kadavath等人,2022年;Tian等人,2023年),严格校准评估至关重要. 我们报告说,有两项标准衡量标准是直接从原始模型分布中计算而无需经过热度测定的:预期校准误差(ECE)和Brier分数。 欧洲经委会通过将预测分为概率箱和计算平均信心和准确性之间的双加权绝对差异,对信心与经验准确性之间的匹配进行了量化。 布里尔分数衡量了预测概率矢量和一热目标之间的平均平方误差,同时奖励准确性和概率校准. 对于这两个指标,数值较低表明表现优异。

blocks.en: 3 The LLM2Jev Framework
blocks.zh: 3. LLM2Jev框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: A decision instance consists of a context state s s , a set of candidate options o 1 , … , o K o_{1},\dots,o_{K} , and a target choice y ∈ { 1 , … , K } y\in\{1,\dots,K\} . The objective is to produce a probability distribution P ⁡ ( k ∣ s ) P(k\mid s) over the candidate set. All three Jev-supported task types map cleanly into this formulation: a verification (yes/no) query specifies two options describing the acceptance criteria for “yes” and “no”, while an ordinal scoring query defines an ordered sequence of graded options.

blocks.en: We query the model using its default chat template with thinking mode disabled, formatting the user prompt as follows: State: { s s } Options: [1] { o 1 o_{1} }  …  [K] { o K o_{K} } Select one option. Answer only with its bracketed numeric identifier. Each candidate is rendered on a separate line. We condition the assistant’s turn on the fixed prefix Best answer: [ , such that selecting option k k corresponds to generating the completion “ k k ] ”. We define this completion as the candidate suffix , represented by the token sequence c k = ( c k , 1 , … , c k , n k ) c_{k}=(c_{k,1},\dots,c_{k,n_{k}}) . This design yields three key advantages: • Unbounded option capacity. Because every candidate suffix terminates with a closing bracket, no complete suffix can serve as the prefix of another (e.g., 1] is not a prefix of 12] ). This prefix-free property supports arbitrarily large candidate sets K K , unlike single-letter readouts that are inherently bounded to 16 or 26 options. • Shallow suffix trie. The candidate suffixes naturally form a prefix tree (trie; Figure 1 ) whose depth is governed by the underlying tokenizer. Tokenizers that process digits individually (such as Qwen’s) yield a trie depth of at most ⌊ log 10 ⁡ K ⌋ + 2 \lfloor\log_{10}K\rfloor+2 . Tokenizers that group digits (such as Phi-4’s) encode any integer up to 999 into a single token, producing a trie of depth two. The scoring rule and loss formulation generalize across any such trie structure (Appendix C ). • Generative compatibility. The model retains the ability to emit structured answers in standard autoregressive text generation. We utilize this text mode to verify that the model adheres to the expected syntax post-training; fine-tuning leaves general generation capabilities intact (§ 4.3.4 ).

blocks.en: Because candidate tokens are scored after conditioning on the complete prompt, the model contextualizes each alternative relative to the full candidate slate. In contrast, multiple community Jev-style models score candidates in isolation: leaderboard rerankers and NLI classifiers evaluate each (state, option) pair independently ( Benchmark Heaven, 2026 ) , CLM-8B embeds each option separately ( Kwok et al., 2026 ) , and jev-local computes individual candidate log-probabilities in separate forward passes ( jev-local contributors, 2026 ) . However, many real-world decision tasks inherently require joint comparison—such as identifying the most cost-effective tier, finding the closest semantic match, or determining whether a query falls under “none of the above”. On public JevBench, jev-local achieves only 74.9% accuracy with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, trailing listwise readouts on the smaller Qwen3.5-4B (81.4%).
blocks.zh: 由于候选人的代号在完全的即时上调后即得分,模型将每个替代品与完全候选人的代号相对应。 相比之下,多个社区Jev风格的模型将候选人单独评分:领导板重新排名者和NLI分类者分别对每个(状态,选项)进行独立评价(基准天堂,2026年),CLM-8B将每个选项分别嵌入(Kwok等人,2026年),Jev-local计算个人候选人的日志概率在单独的前置通行证(jev-local positions,2026年)中. 然而,许多现实世界的决策任务必然需要联合比较,例如确定最符合成本效益的层次,找到最接近的语义匹配,或确定询问是否属于“上述任何一种情况”。 在公开的Jev Bench上,jev-local仅实现了74.9%的精度,用冷冻的Quen3.5-9B,在较小的Quen3.5-4B(81.4%)上顺着列表读出.

blocks.en: A known trade-off of joint scoring is susceptibility to option order, reflecting the well-documented position bias in LLMs ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2023 ) . We mitigate this during fine-tuning by randomly shuffling candidate order across training instances, ensuring that numeric identifiers carry no static semantic association; consequently, fine-tuned models exhibit greater consistency across cyclic option rotations on MMBench (Appendix F ). While inference-time permutation averaging ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) can further reduce residual bias, it incurs proportional computational overhead, and we omit it to prioritize efficiency.
blocks.zh: 联合评分的一个已知的权衡是选择顺序的易感性,反映了LLMs(郑等人,2024年;Pezeshkpour和Hruschka,2023年)中记录齐全的立场偏差。 在微调过程中,我们通过在培训中随机打乱候选人的顺序来缓解这种情况,确保数字识别符不包含静态语义关联;因此,微调模型在MMBench(附录F)上的循环选项旋转中表现出更大的一致性。 虽然推算时间平均(Zhang等人,2026年)可以进一步减少剩余偏差,但会产生比例计算间接费用,我们省略了它以优先提高效率。

blocks.en: Because all candidate suffixes are known a priori , they can be evaluated concurrently rather than decoded sequentially. After computing the key-value (KV) activations for the prompt prefix x x , we cache them and evaluate candidate branches in parallel via teacher forcing, mirroring the parallel sampling strategy in Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Suffixes of identical length can be batched together. With sufficient batch capacity, even a 151-way classification task requires only one prompt prefill and at most three short forward passes under digit-level tokenizers, or a single forward pass under multi-digit tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 因为所有候选人的后缀都是先验的,所以可以同时评价,而不是依次解码. 在计算了快速前缀xxx的键值(KV)激活后,我们缓存这些键值,并通过教师强制并行评价候选分支,与Jev(Almeida, 2026)中的平行采样策略相对应. 相同长度的后缀可以一起批量. 拥有足够的批量容量,即使是151路的分类任务,也只需要一次即时预填,最多三次短的前行通过数位标定器下,或者一次前行通过数位标定器下.

blocks.en: Effective fine-tuning should enhance decision accuracy without collapsing the general-purpose foundation model into a narrow, brittle classifier. We thus aim for minimal behavioral intervention: parameter updates should adjust only the relative preferences among candidate identifiers while preserving all other predictive behaviors of the base model. Specifically, the total probability mass allocated to valid syntax, the internal rankings of non-target tokens, and next-token distributions across unrelated contexts should remain faithful to the original pre-trained model. We achieve this by pairing a tree-factorized listwise loss with Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence anchors.
blocks.zh: 有效的微调应可提高决策的准确性,而不会使通用基础模型变成一个狭义、简洁的分类器。 因此,我们的目标是最小的行为干预:参数更新只应调整候选识别器之间的相对偏好,同时保留基准模型的所有其他预测行为. 具体地说,分配给有效语法的总概率质量,非目标符号的内部排名,以及不相关语境的下位分布,应该仍然忠实于最初的事先训练的模式. 我们通过将一个树因子列表损失与Kullback-Leibler(KL)偏差锚对齐来实现这一点。

(5) Here, KL B \mathrm{KL}_{\mathrm{B}} represents the KL divergence between Bernoulli distributions over the partition of legal versus illegal tokens. The distribution p ¯ ( ⋅ ∣ v ) \bar{p}(\cdot\mid v) denotes the probability distribution renormalized over illegal tokens at node v v , while u u indexes positions outside the candidate suffix. Anchor targets and their respective weighting factors ω \omega are distributed as follows: • Trie nodes: all nodes along the gold path (total weight 0.5) and three randomly sampled off-path nodes (total weight 0.5). • Context positions: the reply start position (weight 0.5) and the position immediately following the closing bracket (weight 0.5). • Tail approximation: we retain the reference model’s top-64 tokens for each anchored distribution (illegal tokens for ℒ out \mathcal{L}_{\text{out}} ; full vocabulary for ℒ pos \mathcal{L}_{\text{pos}} ) and aggregate remaining probability mass into an individual tail bucket. blocks.en: Tail approximation: we retain the reference model’s top-64 tokens for each anchored distribution (illegal tokens for ℒ out \mathcal{L}_{\text{out}} ; full vocabulary for ℒ pos \mathcal{L}_{\text{pos}} ) and aggregate remaining probability mass into an individual tail bucket. By the data processing inequality, this truncated divergence forms a rigorous lower bound on the full KL penalty while substantially saving computation.

blocks.en: We support both full-parameter fine-tuning of the language model and LM head, and parameter-efficient tuning via LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) applied to all linear projections within decoder blocks; LoRA weights are merged into base checkpoints post-training to guarantee identical inference latency. Optimization uses AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) under Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP; Zhao et al. 2023 ) with a conservative learning rate, linear warmup and cosine decay, shuffled candidate ordering, and a single training epoch. An automated validation check halts training if the probability mass on legal tokens drops substantially relative to the base model. Complete hyperparameter specifications are detailed in Table 3 (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 我们支持对语言模型和LM头进行全参数微调,支持通过LORA(Hu等人,2022年)对解码区块内的所有线性预测进行参数效率微调;LORA权重被合并为基地检查站后训练,以保证相同的推论间隔. 优化使用AdamW(Lohchilov and Hutter, 2019)在Fully Sharded Data并行论(FSDP; Zhao等人, 2023年)下,具有保守的学习率,线性热身和余弦衰变,洗牌候选人订购,以及单一的训练时代. 如果与基准模型相比,法律标志上的概率质量大幅下降,自动验证检查将停止培训。 完整的超参数规格详见表3(附录A)。

blocks.en: 3.5 Training Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训数据建设

blocks.en: We curate training sets exclusively from publicly accessible, human-annotated datasets, converting each source into our unified decision template without altering ground-truth labels or soliciting synthetic labels from teacher models. To prevent train-test contamination, we filter all training instances that share a 13-word n-gram (or an identical sentence of six or more words) with any evaluation benchmark, and purge exact duplicates of validation inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们专门从可公开查阅的、附有人名说明的数据集中管理培训,将每个来源转换成我们统一的决定模板,而不改变地面真实的标签或从教师模型中索取合成标签。 为了防止火车测试污染,我们过滤所有与任何评估基准共用13字n克(或相同句子为6个或更多字)的训练实例,并清除确切重复的验证投入。

blocks.en: Training mixtures were developed iteratively: we began with canonical intent-classification tasks highlighted in early Jev demonstrations ( Almeida, 2026 ) , subsequently incorporating reasoning and long-context corpora to expand coverage. Because subsequent data iterations were motivated by error analysis on public JevBench samples, we treat the evaluations in § 4.3.3 as exploratory; JevBench was strictly excluded from hyperparameter tuning and checkpoint selection. Section 4.3 details each data mixture, and Appendix D provides complete dataset breakdowns.
blocks.zh: 训练混合物是反复开发的:我们首先在早期Jev示威(Almeida, 2026年)中强调的犬科意图分类任务, 由于后续的数据迭代是由公共Jev Bench样本的错误分析所激发的,我们把§4.3.3中的评价作为探索性;Jev Bench被严格排除在超参数调制和检查站选择之外. 第4.3节详细介绍了每种数据混合物,附录D提供了完整的数据集细分。

blocks.en: Without task-specific adaptation, frozen Qwen3.5-4B correctly resolves 188 of the 231 public JevBench instances (81.4%; Table 2 ). This performance matches or exceeds dedicated community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, including SemIf (186 correct via single-letter logits; 15 wins vs. 13 losses, p = 0.85 p=0.85 ) and fine-tuned reflex 4B (184 correct). Among evaluated baselines, only the substantially larger Winnow-12B (86.6%) and proprietary GPT-5.6 Sol (94.4%) achieve higher accuracy. Across External benchmarks, our training-free recipe surpasses SemIf by 3.2 percentage points in macro accuracy, winning 313 instances while losing 154 ( p < 10 − 12 p<10^{-12} ), driven by substantial advantages on MMLU (+123/ − - 56), MMLU-Pro (+96/ − - 41), and ARC-C (+28/ − - 8). Because both systems share identical base weights, these gains confirm the efficacy of joint candidate conditioning and prefix-free scoring.
blocks.zh: 没有针对特定任务的调整,冻结的Quen3.5-4B正确解决了231个公开的Jev Bench案例中的188个(81.4%);表2. 这种性能匹配或超过基于同一主干线的专用社区Jev型模型,包括SemIf(186通过单字母对数正确;15胜13负,p=0.85 p=0.85)和微调反射4B(184正确). 在评价的基线中,只有大得多的Winnow-12B(86.6%)和专有的GPT-5.6 Sol(94.4%)的准确度更高。 在整个外部基准中,我们的无培训食谱在宏观准确度上超过了3.2个百分点,赢得了313个案例,而损失了154个案例(p < 10 - 12 p < 10 - 12 }),这是由于在MMLU(+123 - - 56)、MMLU-Pro(+96/ - - 41)和ARC-C(+28/ - 8)上的巨大优势。 由于两种系统都具有相同的基重,这些增益证实了联合候选条件和前缀无积分的功效.

blocks.en: Our framework naturally accommodates all 77 candidate intents in Banking77 within a single inference pass, achieving 69.0% accuracy. In contrast, standard letter-logit readouts cannot be applied to such tasks without fundamentally altering their prompt formulation (§ 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的框架自然能满足银行银行77的所有77个候选意图,在单一的推断证中达到69.0%的准确度。 与此相反,标准字母记录读出不能在不从根本上改变其即时写法的情况下适用于这些任务(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: The training-free 4B model achieves an ECE of 0.057 on JevBench out of the box, outperforming both SemIf (0.061) and reflex 4B (0.070, even when incorporating its official calibration mapping).
blocks.zh: 无培训的4B模式在Jev Bench上实现了0.057的ECE值,其表现优于SemIf(0.061)和反射4B(0.070),即使纳入了正式校准绘图。

blocks.en: When prompted to generate responses autoregressively under greedy decoding, the 4B model achieves identical accuracy (81.4%) with zero parse failures, selecting the exact same candidate as parallel scoring across all 231 instances. This verifies that our prompt template aligns seamlessly with the model’s natural generation behavior.
blocks.zh: 当激励在贪婪的解码下自动生成响应时,4B模型实现相同的精确度(81.4%),零解析失败,在所有231个实例中选择与平行评分完全相同的候选人. 这证明了我们的即时模板与模型的自然生成行为无缝配合。

blocks.en: Because LLM2Jev introduces no specialized classification heads or modality-specific architectures, any vision-language backbone can evaluate multimodal queries through the identical interface. By prepending image tokens to the prompt, Qwen3.5-4B achieves 82.4% on MMBench under CircularEval (which requires consistent predictions across all option permutations) and 64.6% on MMStar without any multimodal tuning. Withholding visual inputs collapses performance to 15.2% and 28.8%, confirming that decisions depend authentically on visual comprehension. Crucially, text-only fine-tuning preserves this multimodal competence (§ 4.3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 因为LLM2 Jev没有引入专门的分类标题或模式特定架构,任何视觉语言主干线都可以通过相同的接口评价多式联运查询. 通过预置图像符符到提示符,Quen3.5-4B在NoperEval(需要在所有选项的排列上一致预测)下在MMBench上达到82.4%,在MMStar上达到64.6%,而没有任何多模式调制. 持有视觉输入器的性能下降至15.2%和28.8%,这证实了决定的真实性依赖于视觉理解. 至关重要的是,只有文本的微调保留了这种多式联运能力(第4.3.4节)。

blocks.en: In contrast to the 4B backbone, the compact Qwen3-0.6B struggles with zero-shot decision extraction. While its 56.7% JevBench accuracy exceeds the raw-logit leaderboard baseline (48.1%), its probabilistic calibration is poor (ECE 0.278), and performance deteriorates sharply on high-cardinality tasks (22.2% on Banking77). On the 151-class CLINC150 validation set, its initial cross-entropy loss reaches 6.9 nats, performing worse than uniform random guessing ( ln ⁡ 151 ≈ 5.0 \ln 151\approx 5.0 ). In autoregressive text mode, the model redundantly emits descriptive option text after the identifier, resulting in 219 syntax failures out of 231 queries. These structural shortcomings highlight where parameter adaptation is genuinely required.
4.3 When Fine-Tuning Helps
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 当精益求精帮助

blocks.en: Fine-tuning yields meaningful dividends when three conditions converge: the base model exhibits deficient zero-shot accuracy on the target domain, task-aligned supervised data is accessible, and the training distribution faithfully reflects the answer topologies and input length distributions encountered at test time. Compact models and focused enterprise domains (such as high-cardinality intent routing) readily satisfy these criteria. Conversely, deploying a capable foundation model over heterogeneous decision tasks (as probed by JevBench) fails to benefit consistently, as public data covers only a subset of the necessary competencies. Below, we systematically substantiate these findings: performance gains closely track the coverage of training tasks (§ 4.3.1 ), unrepresented formats risk behavioral regression (§§ 4.3.2 – 4.3.3 ), and backbone capacity governs the net utility of adaptation (§ 4.3.4 ). Figure 3 summarizes outcomes across all six training configurations, with full metrics reported in Table 8 (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 微调在三个条件汇合时产生有意义的红利:基础模型显示目标域上的零射精度不足,任务对齐的监管数据可以访问,训练分布忠实地反映了测试时遇到的答案地形和输入长度分布. 契约模式和重点企业领域(如高心率意图路由)随时符合这些标准。 相反,在各种决策任务(如Jev Bench所调查的)上部署一个有能力的基础模型不能始终受益,因为公共数据只涵盖一部分必要的能力。 下文我们系统地证实了这些调查结果:业绩的提高密切跟踪培训任务的覆盖面(第4.3.1节),无代表格式的风险行为回归(§4.3.2-4.3.3),以及主干能力支配适应的净效用(第4.3.4节)。 图3汇总了所有六个培训组合的成果,表8(附录F)报告了完整的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Performance Gains Track Supervised Task Coverage
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 业绩收益监督 任务覆盖范围

blocks.en: Empirical improvements concentrate squarely on tasks directly represented in the training mixtures where base models exhibit baseline weaknesses, while unrepresented domains remain largely static (Figure 3 ). Because every training mixture incorporates intent classification, Banking77—initially among the lowest-scoring External tasks across both scales—improves consistently under all configurations. Similarly, datasets containing commonsense questions boost WinoGrande accuracy at the 4B scale. In contrast, knowledge-intensive benchmarks absent from the training corpora, such as MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and TriviaQA, demonstrate negligible gains. Notably, semantic task structure outweighs superficial vocabulary overlap: MMLU and MMLU-Pro show no advancement despite having the highest lexical similarity to ReClor and LogiQA (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 经验方面的改进完全集中在直接体现在培训混合物中的任务上,在这些混合物中,基础模型显示出基线弱点,而无人任职的领域基本上保持不变(图3)。 由于每一种培训混合物都包含意向分类,银行业务77——最初是两个比额表中得分最低的外部任务之一——在所有组合下始终如一地改进。 同样,包含常识问题的数据集在4B尺度上提升了WinoGrande的精度. 与此相反,培训公司缺乏知识密集型基准,如MMLU、MMLU-Pro和TriviaQA,表明收益微不足道。 值得注意的是,语义任务结构超过了表面词汇的重叠:MMLU和MMLU-Pro尽管与ReClor和LogiQA(附录E)具有最高的语法相似性,但没有表现出任何进步。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Intent Supervision: Domain Gains Coupled with Heuristic Shortcuts
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 意图监督:领域收益与高uristic快捷键相结合

blocks.en: We initially trained on an intent set combining three multi-class intent datasets ( Larson et al., 2019 ; FitzGerald et al., 2023 ; Bitext, 2024 ) with CommonsenseQA ( Talmor et al., 2019 ) and HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) . While this mixture sharply improves in-domain intent routing on Banking77, it induces detrimental heuristic shortcuts across diverse decision tasks. After a single epoch, error analysis on JevBench reveals four distinct failure modes in the 4B model: an aggressive confirmation bias toward “yes” on binary verification queries, severe suppression of “none of the above” fallback options, reliance on superficial lexical matches, and marked overconfidence. These regressions stem directly from distributional omissions in the training corpus: the intent data lacks verification tasks, rarely rewards fallback candidates, can be largely resolved via surface keyword matching, and relies on only four static prompt templates. Crucially, KL anchors cannot prevent such distributional collapse because they permit arbitrary probability redistribution among valid option candidates. Prolonged training exacerbates this degradation: JevBench accuracy drops from 81.4% (zero-shot) to 79.2% at 100 steps and 76.2% after a full epoch, even as in-distribution validation loss continues to improve monotonically. The affirmative bias emerges as early as step 100, demonstrating that data composition—rather than training duration alone—governs transfer fidelity (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 我们最初接受了将三个多类意图数据集(Larson等人,2019年;FitzGerald等人,2023年;Bitext,2024年)与CommonsenseQA(Talmor等人,2019年)和HellaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年)相结合的意向集培训。 虽然这种混合大大改进了银行业务77的域内意图路线,但它在各种决策任务中诱发了有害的急速捷径。 在划时代之后,对Jev Bench的错误分析揭示了4B模型中四种截然不同的失败模式:对二进制验证查询的“是”的激进确认偏好、对“上述任何一种”倒置选项的严厉压制、对表面词汇匹配的依赖以及明显的过度自信。 这些回归直接源于训练大纲中的分布性遗漏:意图数据缺乏核查任务,很少奖励回落的考生,基本上可以通过表面关键词匹配解决,只依靠四个静态即时模板. 关键的是,KL锚无法防止这种分布式崩溃,因为它们允许在有效选项候选人之间任意的概率再分配。 长时间的训练加剧了这种退化:Jev Bench精度从81.4%(零射)下降到79.2%(100步),并在一个完整的时代之后下降到76.2%,即使分配中验证损失继续单调改善. 平权倾向早在第100步就出现,表明数据构成——而不是仅仅培训期限——政府转移忠诚(附录G)。

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Balancing Verification Formats and Sequence Lengths
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 平衡核查格式和顺序长度

blocks.en: To address the limitations of pure intent tuning, we designed targeted reasoning mixtures (treated as exploratory, given that data selection was informed by prior error analysis). We replaced the commonsense corpora with six reasoning benchmarks covering balanced rule verification, “none of the above” fallbacks, formal argumentation, and binary commonsense ( Tafjord et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2019 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Bisk et al., 2020 ; Bhagavatula et al., 2020 ) . The resulting configuration (Reason-9k) successfully curbs the affirmative bias and yields the best probabilistic calibration observed at 4B while matching zero-shot JevBench accuracy. However, scaling short-context reasoning data proves counterproductive: expanding to Reason-21k and Reason-30k (incorporating Schuster et al. 2021 ; Rogers et al. 2020 ; Sap et al. 2019 ) depresses JevBench accuracy, with errors heavily concentrated on long-context instances unrepresented in the short training samples. Augmenting the mixture with three long-context corpora ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ; Trivedi et al., 2022 ; Pang et al., 2022 ) (Reason+Long-12k) fully restores long-sequence performance to base-model levels (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 为了解决纯意图调试的局限性,我们设计了有针对性的推理混合物(由于数据选择是以事先的错误分析为依据的,因此作为探索性的)。 我们用6个推理基准取代了commonsense Corpora, 包括均衡的规则核查, “上述任何一种”倒置, 正式论证, 和二元共性(Tafjord等人, 2021年;Huang等人, 2019年; Yu等人, 2020年;Liu等人, 2023年; Bisk等人, 2020年; Bhagavatula等人, 2020年)。 由此形成的配置(Reason-9k)成功地抑制了正偏偏,并产生了在4B观测到的最佳概率校准,同时匹配了零射的Jev Bench精度. 然而,缩放短文推理数据证明是适得其反的:扩展为理性-21k和理性-30k(包含舒斯特等人. 2021; Rogers et al. 2020; Sap 等人 2019) 淡化Jev Bench精度,错误大量集中在短训样本中无人代理的长文实例. 将混合物加成三个长文corpora(Koreeda和Manning,2021年;Trivedi等人,2022年;Pang等人,2022年)(Reason+Long-12k)将长序性能完全恢复到基模水平(Appendix G.).

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Model Scale Governs Adaptation Utility
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 示范规模政府适应工具

blocks.en: Model scale dictates the net return on fine-tuning: compact backbones experience widespread structural gains, whereas capable models benefit strictly along targeted axes. Because baseline Qwen3-0.6B lacks native adherence to the structured answer format, fine-tuning substantially enhances high-cardinality decision accuracy and calibration across all domains. Conversely, because Qwen3.5-4B already exhibits robust format compliance and calibrated decision boundaries out of the box, full-parameter fine-tuning yields no net gain on broad out-of-distribution benchmarks like JevBench (76.2–80.5% vs. 81.4%), with meaningful improvements restricted to targeted domains like Banking77. Only parameter-efficient adaptation via LoRA manages to improve the 4B baseline on JevBench (+2.6 points; § 4.4.3 ). Reassuringly, fine-tuning at both scales preserves general linguistic capabilities without significant degradation (Appendix G ), and the 4B model fully maintains its zero-shot multimodal decision faculties despite text-only training (Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 模型尺度决定了微调后的净回报:紧凑的骨干在结构上取得了广泛的收益,而有能力的模型则严格按照目标轴线受益。 由于基准Qwen3-0.6B缺乏对结构化答案格式的本土坚持,微调大大增强了所有领域的高心力决定准确度和校准度. 反之,由于Quen3.5-4B已经显示严格格式的合规性,并调整了框内的决定界限,因此,如Jev Bench(76.2-80.5%对81.4%)等广泛的分配基准,全参数微调不会产生净收益,有意义的改进仅限于银行77等目标领域。 只有通过LORA实现参数高效的适应,才能改进Jev Bench上的4B基线(+2.6分;§4.4.3.)。 令人欣慰的是,两种规模的微调都保留了一般语言能力,没有明显的退化(附录G),4B模式尽管只经过文字培训,但完全保持了零镜头的多式联运决策能力(表11)。

blocks.en: Practical deployment entails critical tuning decisions, notably whether to update all parameters or employ parameter-efficient adapters, and how aggressively to anchor auxiliary token distributions. We systematically investigate these design choices by retraining Reason+Long-12k across anchor weights λ ∈ { 1 , 0.1 , 0.01 , 0 } \lambda\in\{1,0.1,0.01,0\} (where λ = 0 \lambda=0 isolates the unconstrained listwise objective) under both full-parameter tuning and LoRA (Figure 4 ; Appendix H ). Our principal recommendations are threefold: retain KL anchors to safeguard generation stability (§ 4.4.1 ), calibrate anchor strength according to model scale (§ 4.4.2 ), and prioritize LoRA for capable backbones (§ 4.4.3 ).
4.4.1 KL Anchoring Safeguards Generative Stability
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 KL 安抚保障

blocks.en: While varying anchor weights induces negligible variance in aggregate benchmark scores, KL regularization is vital for maintaining behavioral fidelity. Because ℒ tree \mathcal{L}_{\text{tree}} provides no gradient signal prior to the candidate token or following the closing bracket, unconstrained optimization permits auxiliary distributions to drift uncontrollably as an unregularized byproduct of shared weight updates. Standard benchmarks completely conceal this pathology: neither JevBench accuracy nor general language modeling metrics decline meaningfully in the absence of anchors. Instead, behavioral collapse manifests in autoregressive generation. Without anchors, the 4B model compulsively continues generating redundant text after the identifier in 69 of the 231 JevBench queries, while the 0.6B model exhibits severe termination failures in conversational chat. Introducing even modest anchor penalties ( λ ≥ 0.01 \lambda\geq 0.01 ) eliminates virtually all format-breaking generations (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 虽然不同锚重会引起总基准分数的可忽略不计的差异,但KL规范化对于保持行为忠诚至关重要。 由于L tree \ mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\text{tree}}}在候选令牌之前或关闭括号之后不提供梯度信号,不受约束的优化允许辅助分布作为共享重量更新的无规律副产品无节制漂移. 标准基准完全掩盖了这种病理学:在没有锚的情况下,Jev Bench精确度和一般语言建模度量度都没有有意义的下降. 相反,行为崩溃表现为自动递减生成. 没有锚,4B模型在231 Jev Bench查询的69个标识后强制继续生成冗余文本,而0.6B模型在对话聊天中显示出严重的终止失败. 采用即使是微小的锚定处罚(λ 0.01\lambda\geq 0.01),几乎消除了所有打破格式的世代(附录H)。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Calibrating Regularization Strength to Model Capacity
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 校准规范化对示范能力的力量

blocks.en: Optimal regularization strength scales inversely with model capacity. Strong anchors ( λ = 1 \lambda=1 ) are optimal for capable models, whereas lighter regularization ( λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 ) benefits smaller backbones under full-parameter tuning. For Qwen3-0.6B, relaxation to λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 yields marginally superior decision accuracy (59.7%) and calibration (ECE 0.101), indicating that smaller models require greater representational plasticity to overcome baseline deficiencies. Conversely, for Qwen3.5-4B, λ = 1 \lambda=1 delivers the highest decision accuracy, confirming that capable models primarily require syntactic alignment without deep parametric shifts. Setting λ ≤ 0.01 \lambda\leq 0.01 , however, leads to statistically significant degeneration in conversational termination at the 0.6B scale (Appendix H ).

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Parameter-Efficient Adaptation vs. Full Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 参数-有效适应与全面调整

blocks.en: We recommend LoRA over full fine-tuning for strong backbones, whereas the two strategies yield comparable results on smaller models. At 4B, LoRA paired with λ = 1 \lambda=1 produces the top-performing model overall, achieving 84.0% on JevBench and consistently surpassing full-parameter tuning across all regularization strengths. This aligns with prior observations that low-rank adaptation mitigates catastrophic forgetting while constraining unnecessary drift ( Biderman et al., 2024a ) . At 0.6B, LoRA and full-parameter models achieve equivalent accuracy within a three-item margin on JevBench. Crucially, parameter efficiency alone is insufficient to substitute for KL anchors: unregularized LoRA models still suffer syntax termination failures in text mode, and unconstrained LoRA on 0.6B exhibits even more severe conversational drift than full fine-tuning (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 我们建议对LORA进行全面调整,以建立强有力的骨干,而这两项战略在较小的模型上产生类似的结果。 在4B时,LORA与QQ=1\lambda=1对齐,产生总体性能最高的模型,在Jev Bench上达到84.0%,并持续超过所有正规化优势的全参数调制. 这与先前的观察一致,即低级适应减轻灾难性的遗忘,同时限制不必要的漂移(Biderman等人,2024a)。 在0.6B时,LORA和全参数模型在Jev Bench上的三项目比值内达到等效的精度. 关键是,仅参数效率不足以取代KL主锚:未规范的LORA模型在文本模式中仍然遭受语法终止故障,在0.6B上没有约束LORA比全微调显示更严重的对话漂移(附录H).

blocks.en: 5 A Practical Recipe
blocks.zh: 5 实用食谱

blocks.en: Synthesizing our empirical results, we propose the following practical guidelines for operationalizing causal LLMs as Jev-style decision systems: • Default to a training-free baseline. A capable foundation model paired with our numbered prefix-free interface provides a strong, well-calibrated starting point without parameter tuning. For multimodal backbones, visual decision capabilities emerge zero-shot out of the box, and newly published LLMs can be evaluated immediately without training delays. • Target adaptation to verified deficiencies. Fine-tuning should be reserved for scenarios where the pre-trained base model exhibits unambiguous weaknesses (e.g., small parameter footprints or high-cardinality routing tasks) and domain-specific annotated data is available. Practitioners should not expect fine-tuning to universally lift accuracy across diverse, heterogeneous decision tasks. • Align training mixtures with target test distributions. Supervised corpora must comprehensively reflect production characteristics, including binary verification, fallback options (such as “none of the above”), and realistic prompt length distributions. We recommend introducing diverse instruction phrasing and pruning trivial instances that can be resolved via shallow keyword heuristics. Modest budgets of a few hundred gradient steps typically suffice. • Enforce KL regularization anchors. Retaining KL anchors is essential to prevent behavioral drift in auxiliary generation contexts. An anchor weight of λ = 1 \lambda=1 provides a robust default across models; for compact models undergoing full-parameter tuning, λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 can offer an effective balance between plasticity and stability. • Adopt LoRA for capable backbones. For medium and large backbones, parameter-efficient adaptation via LoRA attains higher peak accuracy while minimizing unwanted drift from the base model’s representation space. • Audit behavior beyond in-domain metrics. Checkpoint selection should rely on out-of-distribution transfer probes rather than in-distribution training loss, which often continues to drop long after general transfer degrades. Crucially, practitioners should inspect autoregressive completions on open-ended prompts, as standard likelihood metrics fail to detect syntax and generation runaway.
blocks.zh: 综合我们的经验成果,我们提出下列实用准则,将因果有限责任公司作为Jev式的决定系统投入运行: 与我们的编号前缀无接口对齐的能动基础模型提供了一个强大的,精准的起点,没有参数调试. 对于多式联运主干线,视觉决策能力出现零射出框,新发布的LLMS可以立即评价,而不会培训延迟. • 以适应经核实的缺陷为目标。 应预留精细调整,以备预训基础模型显示出明确弱点(例如,小参数足迹或高心率路由任务)和有特定领域附加说明数据的情景。 从业人员不应期望在各种不同的决策任务中进行微调,以普遍提高准确性。 • 使训练混合物与目标试验分布相一致。 监督的公司必须全面反映生产特点,包括二进制验证、倒置选项(如“上述任何一种”)和现实的即时长度分布。 我们建议采用不同的教学措辞和微小实例,通过浅显关键词推论解决。 几百个梯度步骤的适度预算通常就足够了。 • 执行KL规范化锚。 保留KL锚对防止辅助生成背景下的行为漂移至关重要. 锚重为 QQ = 1\lambda = 1 提供了跨模型的强烈默认值;对于正在进行全参数调试的紧凑模型, QQ = 0.1\lambda = 0.1 能够提供可塑性和稳定性之间的有效平衡. • 为有能力的骨干采用LORA。 就中大型骨干而言,通过LORA进行参数效率调整的峰值精确度较高,同时尽量减少从基准模型的表示空间中不必要的漂移。 • 超出域内衡量标准的审计行为。 检查站的选择应依靠分配外转移探头,而不是分配内培训损失,这种损失往往在一般转移退化很久后继续下降。 关键是,从业者应检查在无限制的提示上自动完成,因为标准概率度量无法检测语法和生成逃逸.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented LLM2Jev, a unified, architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated Jev-style decisions from general-purpose causal LLMs through structured prefix-free conditioning, with or without parameter adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models out of the box: without training, Qwen3.5-4B matches competitive community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, supports arbitrary candidate counts, and natively handles multimodal visual decisions. Fine-tuning yields targeted rather than universal improvements, proving most valuable for compact backbones and specialized domains while offering diminishing returns on capable foundation models. Finally, our KL divergence anchors prevent generative degeneration across conversational contexts, establishing a reliable, lightweight bridge between generative foundation models and deterministic decision systems.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LLM2Jev,一个统一的,结构保存框架,通过结构化的前缀自由调制,从通用因果LLMs中提取校准的Jev风格决定,无论是否参数适应. 我们的研究结果表明,现代有限责任公司在本质上是有效的决策模式:没有培训,Quen3.5-4B就与基于同一支柱的具有竞争力的社区Jev型模式相匹配,支持任意的候选者计数,本土处理多式联运的视觉决定。 精细调整的产量有的放矢,而不是普遍改进,证明对紧凑的骨干和专门领域最有价值,同时在有能力的基础上提供收益。 最后,我们的KL差异锚点防止了在对话背景下的基因退化,在基因基础模型和决定性决策系统之间建立了可靠、轻量级的桥梁。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: The full user-message template is: State: {state} Options: [1] {option 1} [2] {option 2} … Select one option. Answer only with its bracketed numeric identifier. We apply the model’s chat template with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False . • Scoring mode appends Best answer: [ to the formatted prompt and computes the log-probability of each candidate suffix “ k k ] ”. • Text mode continues the same prompt, including Best answer: [ , with greedy generation for up to 32 new tokens and stops at EOS. An answer counts only if the prefilled bracket and the generated text together form exactly [ k k ] ; answers that reach the token limit count as parse failures. We take each candidate’s suffix tokens from the tokenization of the full string, the prompt followed by the suffix, and check that the prompt’s tokens form a prefix of it, so all candidates share one prompt prefill (Appendix C ).

MMBench-EN v1.1 dev asks each of its 1,292 questions under every rotation of its options (4,876 prompts) and counts a question as correct only if all rotations are answered correctly (CircularEval). MMStar has 1,500 questions selected so that they require the image; we exclude two whose correct option is empty. We evaluate the original model and the largest configuration in each group of Table 1 : Intent-1ep, Reason-30k, and Reason+Long-12k. Qwen3-0.6B has no vision encoder. We use VLMEvalKit’s builds of both benchmarks ( Duan et al., 2024 ) , the versions named in Qwen’s model card, and verify them against VLMEvalKit’s published checksums. The state holds a fixed instruction, MMBench’s hint when present, and the question. All models use the original model’s image processor. We downscale images to at most 1,048,576 pixels so that FP32 inference fits on 24 GB GPUs; this affects 0.5% of MMBench prompts and 2.7% of MMStar prompts. Qwen3.5 assigns image tokens rotary positions from the image grid rather than from their order, so each candidate branch continues from the prompt’s largest position; the cached scores match a full recomputation of every candidate to within 10 − 5 10^{-5} . No 13-word window is shared between the image questions and any training set. Qwen reports 89.4 on MMBench and 78.3 on MMStar for generated answers ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , so our scores are not directly comparable.

blocks.en: We check the chat behavior of the ablation models (§ 4.4 ). We take 50 prompts from each of Dolly-15k’s eight categories in a fixed seeded order, dropping duplicates and prompts longer than 4,000 characters; any context follows the instruction after a blank line. Classification, closed QA, and information extraction form 150 short-answer prompts, where the right behavior is to answer and stop; the other five categories are long-form. MT-Bench adds 80 two-turn questions, whose second turn follows the model’s own first reply, for 560 replies per model. Decoding uses the chat template with thinking disabled, BF16, greedy search, and no repetition penalty, and stops at the end-of-turn or end-of-text token or after 1,024 new tokens. Each original model and its fine-tuned models run on the same GPU type with the same batch size and order. We count replies that do not end within 1,024 tokens and repetition loops, in which at least half of the word 4-grams are repeats ( Welleck et al., 2020 ) . Some legitimate answers exceed 1,024 tokens (69 of the 4B original’s replies), so we compare each reply with the original model’s reply to the same prompt and count changes in both directions. The loop threshold flags 1 of the 4B original’s replies and 6 of the 0.6B original’s. Two Dolly prompts share a 13-word window with MuSiQue training paragraphs. Dolly-15k is released under CC BY-SA 3.0 and the MT-Bench prompts under Apache 2.0.

blocks.en: The LLM2Jev interface imposes only one formal invariant: the token sequence of the prompt prefix must strictly form a prefix of the full tokenization for each completed candidate. The structural topology of the candidate trie, however, depends on how the underlying tokenizer segments numeric strings. We systematically evaluated three widely used tokenizer families across a 1,000-option prompt (Figure 5 ); all three yield structurally prefix-free tries for identifiers 1 through 1,000.
blocks.zh: LLM2Jev接口只强制了一个正式的不变量:即时前缀的符号序列必须严格地为每个已完成的候选者形成一个完整的符号化的前缀. 然而,候选三体的结构地形取决于基础的代词器如何分数弦. 我们系统地评估了3个广泛使用的标致剂家庭的1 000可选提示(图5);所有3个都为1至1 000的识别符做了结构前缀无限制的尝试。

blocks.en: Figure 5: How three tokenizer families split the candidate suffixes, and the procedure that handles all of them. (a) Digit-level tokenizers give a deeper trie in which options 1 and 10 share their first token. (b) Tokenizers that group up to three digits give a depth-two trie. (c) SentencePiece adds a word-start token when a suffix is tokenized on its own; taking suffix tokens from the full string (step 2) avoids it. We checked identifiers 1 to 1,000 with five tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 图5:三个象征性家庭如何分割候选人的后缀,以及处理所有候选人的程序. (a) 数字级的标致器提供了更深的三重功能,其中选项1和10共享它们的第一个标致。 (b) 最多3位数的助推器可进行深度-二位。 (c) 句子Piece在后缀单独表示时会添加一个词首符号;从全弦(第2步)中提取后缀符号可以避免. 我们检查了1到1 000个身份识别器和5个标识器。

blocks.en: Qwen and Llama 2 tokenize digits individually, so an identifier with d d digits takes d + 1 d+1 tokens, and the trie has depth ⌊ log 10 ⁡ K ⌋ + 2 \lfloor\log_{10}K\rfloor+2 . Tokenizers that group up to three digits, such as those of Phi-4 and Phi-4-mini, make every identifier up to 999 a single token followed by the closing bracket, so the trie has depth two. Scoring then needs one short forward step after the prompt prefill instead of up to three, and the tree-factorized loss reduces to a flat cross-entropy over the legal first tokens. Beyond 999, identifiers span several tokens again (1000 becomes 100 0 ), but the closing bracket keeps the suffixes prefix-free, so the number of options remains unlimited.
blocks.zh: Quen 和 Llama 2 单独标定数字, 所以一个带有 d 位数的标识符需要 d + 1 d + 1 个符号, 三进制有深度 QQ 日志 10 K + 2\ llode\log 10} K\rrode+2 . 这个组最多有三位数的切除器,如Phi-4和Phi-4-mini,使每个识别器最多达到999个符号,然后是关闭括号,所以三进制有深度二. 然后在快速预填后需要向前走一个短的步子,而不是最多三个,树构损失会减少成一个扁平的跨直径,凌驾于法定的先兆上. 999年以后,标识符又跨过数个令牌(1000年变成100年),但关闭的括号保持后缀前缀的无限制,因此选项数量仍然无限.

blocks.en: SentencePiece tokenizers such as that of Llama 2 treat the start of a string as the start of a word. Tokenized on its own, the suffix 1] therefore gains a word-start token that it never has in context, where it follows the opening bracket. We take each suffix’s tokens from the tokenization of the full string instead and check that the prompt’s tokens form a prefix of it. The prompt tokens are then identical across candidates, so parallel decoding with one shared prompt prefill is unaffected. A tokenizer that merged the prompt’s final token with the start of a suffix would fail this check; ending the prefill with an opening bracket avoids such merges for all tokenizers we checked. For Qwen, taking suffix tokens from the full string or from the suffix alone gives identical results.
blocks.zh: PriedPiece的标语符,如Llama 2的标语符,将字符串的起始作为单词的起始. 因此,单词后缀1]就获得了它从未在上下文中出现的文字启动符号,在上下文中它跟随开括号。 我们从整条字符串的符号化中取下每个后缀的符号,然后检查提示的符号是否构成其前缀。 因此,与一个共享的即时预填同时解码不受影响。 将提示的最后代号与后缀的开始合并的标语符会失败此检查; 用打开括号结束预填可以避免我们检查过的所有标语符的这种合并 。 对于Quen来说,从全弦或单从后缀中取出后缀符,结果相同.

blocks.en: With tokenizers that split digits individually, the suffixes of options 1 and 10 share their first token, and the next node chooses between the closing bracket and 0 . Tokenizers that group digits remove this shared node, so they offer a way to isolate the option-10 effect described in Appendix H .

blocks.en: Table 11 gives the results. None of the three fine-tuned models declines significantly on either benchmark. Reason-30k and Reason+Long-12k raise MMBench accuracy to 85.1% and 84.6% (54 wins vs. 18 losses and 44 vs. 15; both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), while MMStar stays within 1.1 points of the original. Almost all MMBench questions that fine-tuning gains are ones the original model answers correctly under some rotations but not others: 42 of 46 for Intent-1ep, 52 of 54 for Reason-30k, and 43 of 44 for Reason+Long-12k. The fine-tuned models also choose the same option under every rotation more often (89.2–91.4% of questions vs. 87.6%), consistent with training on shuffled options. Each benchmark has six categories. Coarse perception on MMBench improves significantly for all three models; of the other 33 model–category pairs, two change significantly, about as many as chance would produce: MMBench relation reasoning rises for Reason-30k (8 wins, 1 loss), and MMStar fine-grained perception falls for Intent-1ep (11 wins, 24 losses). Calibration improves slightly: MMStar ECE falls from 0.090 to 0.051–0.077, and MMBench ECE stays between 0.011 and 0.016.

blocks.en: Appendix G Details of the Data Comparisons

blocks.en: This appendix provides extended qualitative and empirical analyses supporting the findings in §§ 4.3.2 – 4.3.4 .
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了广泛的定性和经验分析,支持第4.3.2至4.3.4段中的结论。

blocks.en: To leverage high-quality human supervision, we began with three public intent-classification benchmarks featuring extensive label sets: CLINC150 ( Larson et al., 2019 ) (151 intents, including an explicit out-of-scope category), MASSIVE en-US ( FitzGerald et al., 2023 ) (60 intents), and Bitext customer support ( Bitext, 2024 ) (27 intents). We added CommonsenseQA ( Talmor et al., 2019 ) and HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) to cover general commonsense reasoning and narrative continuation. Following cleaning and deduplication, this intent set comprises 95,461 instances, roughly half of which represent multi-class intent queries.
blocks.zh: 为了利用高质量的人类监督,我们首先提出了三项公共意图分类基准,其中包括广泛的标签: CLINC150(Larson等人,2019年) (151个意向,包括一个明确的范围外类别),MASSIVE en-US(FitzGerald等人,2023年) (60个意向),以及Bitext客户支持(Bitext,2024年) (27个意向). 我们增加了CommonsenseQA(Talmor等人,2019年)和HellaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年),以涵盖一般常识推理和叙事续作. 在清理和分解后,这套意图包括95 461例,其中大约一半是多类意图查询。

blocks.en: We compared 100 steps on the intent set (Intent-100, 3,000 examples) with one full epoch (Intent-1ep, 2,984 steps). For 4B, longer training makes transfer worse: JevBench accuracy falls from 81.4% to 79.2% after 100 steps and to 76.2% after the full epoch (10 wins, 22 losses, p = 0.05 p=0.05 ). The full-epoch run also reduces External macro accuracy by 0.9 points (pooled p = 0.002 p=0.002 ). Yet the in-distribution development loss continues to fall (Bitext: 0.65 → \rightarrow 0.002), while the development check based on text generation plateaus at about 500 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们把100个步骤(intent-100,3000例)与一个完整的时代(intent-1ep,2,984步)相比较. 对于4B,较长的训练使得转会更加糟糕:Jev Bench的精度从100步后的81.4%下降到79.2%,到全程(10胜22败,p=0.05p=0.05)后的76.2%. 全程运行还降低了外部宏精度0.9分(集合p=0.002 p=0.002). 然而,分配内开发损失继续下降(Bitext: 0.65 →\rightarrow 0.02),而基于文本生成高原的开发检查则在大约500步.

blocks.en: Qualitative error analysis of individual predictions from Intent-1ep reveals four systematic failure modes: • A bias toward “yes”. The probability of “yes” increases on 63 of the 74 yes/no items. The number of “yes” predictions rises from 36 to 50, although only 35 items have “yes” as the correct answer. Of the 11 new yes/no errors, 10 occur when the correct answer is “no”. • Avoiding “none of these”. The mean probability assigned to catch-all options falls from 0.056 to 0.008. • Keyword matching. On hard multiple-choice items, the model more often follows misleading keyword cues in the question. • Overconfidence. ECE rises from 0.057 to 0.116, and mean confidence in incorrect answers rises from 0.60 to 0.73. Meanwhile, the same runs gain 5.7 and 6.5 points on Banking77: the data teaches what it covers, and the failures come from what it leaves out. The training data offers plausible explanations for these patterns. It contains no yes/no or verification questions, most intent examples can be solved by keyword matching, and all examples use just four fixed instruction templates. “None of these” is correct in only 250 of the 95,461 examples. Even Intent-100 shows a “yes” bias (54 “yes” answers), pointing to data composition rather than training duration alone. The same intent data produces a similar bias at 0.6B (51 “yes” answers).
blocks.zh: 对Intent-1ep的个别预测进行定性误差分析,发现有四种系统故障模式: 偏向“是”。 在74个是/否项目中,63个项目的“是”概率增加。 “是”预测的数目从36个增加到50个,尽管只有35个项目有“是”作为正确答案。 在11个新的是/否错误中,10个错误发生在正确答案是“否”时。 · 避免“无一例外”。 分配给所有选项的平均概率从0.056降至0.008。 • 关键词匹配。 在硬的多选择项目上,模型更经常地遵循问题中的误导关键词提示. • 过度自信。 欧洲经委会从0.057增至0.116,对错误答案的自信从0.60增至0.73。 同时,银行业务也获得了5.7和6.5分:数据教它涵盖的内容,失败来自它遗漏的内容。 培训数据对这些模式提供了合理解释。 它包含没有"是/否"或验证问题,大多数意向示例可以通过关键词匹配来解决,所有示例只使用四个固定指令模板. 在95 461个例子中,只有250个“无”正确。 即使意向100也显示出“是”的偏差(54个“是”的答复),表明数据构成,而不只是培训时间。 同样的意向数据在0.6B(51个“是”的答复)产生类似的偏差。

blocks.en: A bias toward “yes”. The probability of “yes” increases on 63 of the 74 yes/no items. The number of “yes” predictions rises from 36 to 50, although only 35 items have “yes” as the correct answer. Of the 11 new yes/no errors, 10 occur when the correct answer is “no”.
blocks.zh: 偏向“是”。 在74个是/否项目中,63个项目的“是”概率增加。 “是”预测的数目从36个增加到50个,尽管只有35个项目有“是”作为正确答案。 在11个新的是/否错误中,10个错误发生在正确答案是“否”时。

blocks.en: Avoiding “none of these”. The mean probability assigned to catch-all options falls from 0.056 to 0.008.
blocks.zh: 避免“无任何此类情况”。 分配给所有选项的平均概率从0.056降至0.008。

blocks.en: Keyword matching. On hard multiple-choice items, the model more often follows misleading keyword cues in the question.
blocks.zh: 关键词匹配 。 在硬的多选择项目上,模型更经常地遵循问题中的误导关键词提示.

blocks.en: Overconfidence. ECE rises from 0.057 to 0.116, and mean confidence in incorrect answers rises from 0.60 to 0.73.
blocks.zh: 过度自信。 欧洲经委会从0.057增至0.116,对错误答案的自信从0.60增至0.73。

blocks.en: To counter these empirical failure modes, we curate a diverse mixture of six reasoning datasets (R6). ProofWriter ( Tafjord et al., 2021 ) supplies rule-based verification with balanced true, false, and unknown answers, filling a gap in the intent set and countering the “yes” bias. CosmosQA ( Huang et al., 2019 ) adds questions where “none of the above” is correct; we upsample these to 16%. ReClor ( Yu et al., 2020 ) and LogiQA 2.0 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) require reasoning about arguments rather than matching keywords. PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) and α \alpha NLI ( Bhagavatula et al., 2020 ) add two-option commonsense questions. Two-option questions account for 32% of JevBench but were absent from the intent set. We retain the three intent-classification datasets (I3) to preserve intent skills and remove CommonsenseQA and HellaSwag. Because the intent-data experiments showed early in-domain gains, we start with only 1,000 examples per dataset and a single pass (Reason-9k, 282 steps). Table 6 compares the two mixtures.
blocks.zh: 为了对抗这些经验性失败模式,我们研究了由六个推理数据集(R6)组成的多种组合. 校对:Soup CosmosQA(Huang等人,2019年)添加了“上述任何一种情况”都是正确的问题;我们把这些例子提高到16%。 ReClor (Yu et al., 2020)和LogiQA 2.0 (Liu et al., 2023) 需要对参数进行推理,而不是匹配关键词. PIQA(Bisk等人,2020年)和α\alpha NLI(Bhagavatula等人,2020年)增加了两种选择的常识问题. 两选项问题占Jev Bench的32%,但在设定的意向中却缺席. 我们保留了三个意图分类数据集(I3),以保留意图技能,并删除CommonsenseQA和HelaSwag. 由于意向数据实验显示了早期的域内收益,所以我们开始每个数据集只有1000个实例和一个单传(Reason-9k,282步). 表6比较了两种混合物。

blocks.en: It improves calibration and reduces the “yes” bias while keeping JevBench accuracy on par with the original: with Reason-9k, the 4B model scores 80.5% (12 wins, 14 losses). Its ECE of 0.046 is the lowest among the systems we evaluate, and “yes” predictions fall to 42. External macro accuracy is 78.8% (+0.2 points). Three per-benchmark changes are significant: WinoGrande +4.2 ( p = 0.013 p=0.013 ), Banking77 +5.6 ( p < 10 − 20 p<10^{-20} ), and MMLU-Pro − 3.2 -3.2 ( p = 0.011 p=0.011 ).
blocks.zh: 它改进了校准,减少了"是"的偏差,同时保持了Jev Bench的准确性与原作相同:由于Reason-9k,4B模型得分80.5%(12胜14败). 欧洲经委会的0.046是评价系统中最低的,“是”预测数降至42。 外部宏精度为78.8%(+0.2分). 每个基准值变化有三个是显著的:WinoGrande +4.2 (p = 0.013 p = 0.013),Banking 77 + 5.6 (p < 10 – 20 p < 10^{-20}),MMLU-Pro − 3.2 -3.2 (p = 0.011 p = 0.011).

blocks.en: We expand the reasoning set in two ways. Reason-21k uses 3,000 examples per reasoning dataset (657 steps). Reason-30k adds three more datasets with 3,000 examples each (938 steps): VitaminC ( Schuster et al., 2021 ) for fact verification, QuAIL ( Rogers et al., 2020 ) for reading comprehension with “not enough information” answers, and Social IQa ( Sap et al., 2019 ) for social commonsense. Neither improves the 4B model’s JevBench accuracy, which falls to 78.4% and 76.6%, respectively. Comparing Reason-30k with Reason-9k gives 5 wins and 14 losses ( p = 0.064 p=0.064 ). External macro accuracy remains nearly unchanged (78.6–78.8%).
blocks.zh: 我们以两种方式扩大了推理范围。 理由21k每个推理数据集使用3000例(657步). 理由-30k 增加了三个数据集,每个集有3000个实例(938个步骤): 维生素C (Shuster等人,2021年)用于事实核实,QuAIL (Rogers等人,2020年)用于阅读“信息不足”答案的理解,以及Social IQa (Sap等人,2019年)用于社会常识. 无论是4B型机车的Jev Bench精度都没有提高,分别下降到78.4%和76.6%. 将“理由”-30k与“理由 ”-9k给出了5胜14败(p=0.064 p=0.064 ) 。 外部宏观精确度几乎保持不变(78.6–78.8%)。

blocks.en: The losses concentrate on the 37 long items. Reason-9k answers 24 correctly, compared with 17 for Reason-21k ( p = 0.016 p=0.016 ) and 16 for Reason-30k ( p = 0.008 p=0.008 ). Both the intent and reasoning mixtures contain prompts no longer than about 570 words, whereas hard JevBench items include long policy documents and multi-hop questions. This mismatch suggests that more training on short inputs can hurt performance on long ones.
blocks.zh: 损失集中于37个长项。 理性-9k回答24正确,与之相比,理性-21k(p = 0.016 p = 0.016)和理性-30k(p = 0.008 p = 0.008)回答16正确. 意图和推理混合物中包含的提示词不超过约570个字,而硬性Jev Bench项目包括长的政策文件和多跳题. 这种不匹配现象表明,更多的短期投入培训会损害长期投入的绩效。

blocks.en: To address the length mismatch, we add three long-input reasoning datasets to Reason-9k, with 1,000 examples each: ContractNLI ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ) for entailment over full contracts, MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) for deciding whether 20 paragraphs contain enough information to answer a multi-hop question, and QuALITY ( Pang et al., 2022 ) for questions about long articles. Their median input lengths range from 2.1k to 6.8k tokens. The resulting configuration, Reason+Long-12k, uses 12,000 examples and 375 steps.
blocks.zh: 为了解决长度不匹配的问题,我们在Reason-9k中增加了三个长输入推理数据集,每个数据集有1000个实例:ContractNLI(Koreeda and Manning, 2021年)关于正式合同的引申,MuSiQue(Trivedi等人, 2022年)关于决定20段是否包含足够的信息以回答一个多跳问题,以及QuALITY(Pang等人, 2022年)关于长文章的问题. 他们的中位输入长度从2.1k到6.8k符号不等. 由此产生的配置"理性+Long-12k"使用了12,000例和375步.

blocks.en: Incorporating long-context corpora successfully reverses sequence-length degradation. Reason+Long-12k scores 80.5% on JevBench, with 11 wins and 2 losses relative to Reason-30k ( p = 0.022 p=0.022 ). It answers 22 long items correctly, with 6 wins and 0 losses relative to Reason-30k ( p = 0.031 p=0.031 ), close to Reason-9k (24) and on par with the original model (21): the long-input data recovers the decline rather than improving on the original model. Reason+Long-12k also trains for fewer steps than Reason-30k (375 vs. 938), which may contribute to the recovery.
blocks.zh: 包含长文本的corpora 成功反转序列长降解. Reason+Long-12k在Jev Bench上得分80.5%,与Reason-30k相比获得11胜2负(p=0.022 p=0.022 ). 它正确回答22个长项,相对理性-30k(p=0.031 p=0.031),接近理性-9k(24),与原模型(21)相同:长期输入数据恢复下降而不是在原模型上改进. Reason+Long-12k的列车步数也少于Reason-30k(375对938),这可能有助于恢复.

blocks.en: Banking77 accuracy rises by 35.0–42.6 points, Reason-9k reduces CLINC150 development loss from 6.91 to 0.89, and ARC-Challenge gains 4.0–7.0 points. Calibration improves as well: JevBench ECE falls from 0.278 to 0.111–0.213, and mean External ECE from 0.272 to 0.077–0.161. JevBench accuracy stays close to the original (54.1–57.1% vs. 56.7%) and reaches 59.7% with lighter anchors (§ 4.4.2 ).
blocks.zh: Banking77精度上升35.0–42.6分,Reason-9k将CLINC150开发损失从6.91降至0.89,ARC-Challenge增益4.0–7.0分. 校准也有所改善:Jev Bench ECE从0.278降至0.111-0.213,指外部ECE从0.272降至0.077-0.161。 Jev Bench的精度保持接近原来的(54.1–57.1%对56.7%),并以更轻的锚(§4.4.2)达到59.7%.

blocks.en: No full-parameter configuration beats the original 4B model on JevBench (76.2–80.5% vs. 81.4%). External macro accuracy stays within ± 0.9 \pm 0.9 points of the original, while Banking77 gains 4.7–6.9 points and WinoGrande 2.0–4.2.
blocks.zh: 在Jev Bench(76.2–80.5%对81.4%)上,没有完整的参数配置比原有的4B模型要好. 外部宏精度保持在0.9\pm0.9的原点内,而Bank77则获得4.7–6.9的分数和WinoGrande2.0–4.2.

blocks.en: No fine-tuned model shows a significant decline in the General average. The 4B model moves from 67.3% to 67.4–68.7% and the 0.6B model from 35.6% to 34.0–36.4% (pooled p ≥ 0.16 p\geq 0.16 ), and WikiText perplexity remains stable (4B: 11.47 → \rightarrow 11.44–11.56; 0.6B: 27.52 → \rightarrow 26.68–27.59). The only significant per-task change is a 6.8-point gain on GSM8K for 0.6B Reason+Long-12k ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ; Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 没有经过微调的模型显示,一般平均数大幅下降。 4B型车由67.3%升至67.4–68.7%,0.6B型车由35.6%升至34.0–36.4%(拼音:p≥0.16 p\geq 0.16),维基文库的穿透度保持稳定(4B:11.47 → 右旋11.44–11.56;0.6B:27.52 → 右旋26.68–27.59). 每个任务的唯一重大变化是0.6B的GSM8K的6.8分收益 reason+Long-12k(p=0.02 p=0.02;表10).

blocks.en: Appendix H Ablation Details
blocks.zh: 附录H 细目

blocks.en: The ablations in § 4.4 reuse the Reason+Long-12k data and schedule (375 steps, 38 warmup steps) and every other setting; only the development health check warns instead of stopping. LoRA adapters wrap every linear layer inside the decoder layers of the language model; embeddings, the LM head, and the vision encoder of Qwen3.5-4B stay frozen. Table 12 gives the results summarized in Figure 4 , Table 13 gives per-task results, and Table 14 gives the drift, text-mode, and chat-behavior measurements.
blocks.zh: §4.4中的再利用Reason+Long-12k数据和时间表(375步,38个热身步骤)和所有其他设置;只有发育健康检查警告而不是停止. LoRA适配器将语言模型的解码器层内部的每个线性层包裹起来;嵌入,LM头,以及Quen3.5-4B的视觉编码器保持冻结. 表12列出了图4概述的结果,表13列出了每项任务的结果,表14列出了漂移、文字模式和聊天行为计量。

blocks.en: No anchor weight changes JevBench accuracy significantly relative to λ = 1 \lambda=1 , for either method at either scale. Without anchors, the listwise loss fits the development data as well as with them (4B tree loss 0.421 vs. 0.424) and does not collapse: in every development dataset, legal tokens keep at least 91% of the probability at the first answer position. General averages do not fall either, and at 4B lighter anchors even raise them (up to + 2.5 +2.5 points at λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 , p = 0.006 p=0.006 ). An early run that used only the listwise loss did collapse: legal mass fell to about e − 17 e^{-17} , JevBench accuracy to 52.8%, and none of the 231 text-mode answers could be parsed. That run motivated the anchors, but it also used a constant learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , no warmup, and a batch size of 3, so we cannot attribute its collapse to the missing anchors alone.
blocks.zh: 锚重没有显著改变Jev Bench的精度相对于QQ = 1\lambda=1,因为这两种方法中的任何一种都是比例法. 没有锚,列表损失也符合开发数据(4B树损失0.421对0.424),不会崩溃:在每一个开发数据集中,合法符号在第一答案位置至少保留91%的概率. 一般平均值也没有下降,在4B较轻的锚点上甚至提高了锚点(在QQ=0.01\lambda=0.01,p=0.006p=0.006). 早期运行只使用列表损失确实崩溃:合法质量下降至约e~17 e^{-17},Jev Bench精度上升至52.8%,231个文本模式解答都无法解析. 运行刺激了锚,但它也使用了 10 -5 10 -Q 5 的恒定学习率,没有热身, 和批量的3, 所以我们不能将崩溃归咎于 缺失的锚。

blocks.en: The listwise loss gives no gradient at the start of the reply or after the answer, so predictions there change only as a side effect of shared weights. Without anchors, the KL divergence from the original model at these two positions grows 47- and 38-fold at 4B, and 49- and 16-fold at 0.6B, relative to λ = 1 \lambda=1 (Table 14 ). In text mode, the 4B model then keeps writing after the identifier on 69 of the 231 JevBench items: 44 answers run to the 32-token limit, mostly with an explanation, and 25 append the option label. Its text accuracy falls to 63.2%, although its scoring accuracy stays at 79.7%. These failures concentrate on long inputs (35 of the 37 long items). For 0.6B, 176 answers reach the limit, compared with 1 at λ = 1 \lambda=1 . A small weight prevents most of this: at λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 , one 4B answer fails to parse and 27 0.6B answers reach the limit.
blocks.zh: 列表损失在回复开始或回复后没有给出梯度,因此预测那里的变化仅仅是作为共享权重的副作用. 没有锚,这两处位置的KL与原型的差值在4B时增长47倍和38倍,在0.6B时增长49倍和16倍,相对QQ=1\lambda=1(表14). 在文本模式中,4B型随后在231 Jev Bench项目69上的标识后继续写作:44个答案运行到32个托肯极限,大多附有解释,25个附加选项标签. 其文本精度降至63.2%,尽管其积分精度保持在79.7%。 这些失败集中于长期投入(37个长项中的35个)。 0.6B,176个答案达到极限,而1个答案在QQ=1\lambda=1. 微小的重量可以阻止其中的大部分:在QQ=0.01\lambda=0.01时,一个4B的答案无法解析,27个0.6B的答案达到了极限.

blocks.en: The behavior check tests whether this drift extends beyond the decision prompt. At 4B, it does not: under every recipe, including λ = 0 \lambda=0 , about as many chat replies newly fail to end as newly end (19 vs. 21 without anchors), and loops stay rare. Trained 4B models only answer short-answer prompts more tersely; at λ = 1 \lambda=1 , for example, the full-parameter model’s replies are shorter than the original model’s on 106 of the 150 such prompts and longer on 33. At 0.6B, the change grows as the anchor weight falls. With full-parameter training, 4, 7, 11, and 20 replies newly fail to end at λ = 1 \lambda=1 , 0.1, 0.01, and 0, against 2 in the other direction each time; the last two differences are significant ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 and p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Most come from long-form Dolly prompts and are often endless numbered lists, as in brainstorming answers. The General scores do not reveal this change: the 0.6B model without anchors has a General average 1.0 point higher than the original, because these tasks score likelihoods, extract the final answer, or check only the stated instructions.
blocks.zh: 行为检查测试这种漂移是否超越了迅速的决定. 在4B时,它不会:在包括QQ=0\lambda=0的每条食谱下,大约有如新结局(19对21没有主播)那样多的聊天回复新未能结束,循环仍然很少. 训练的4B型机只回答短答的提示音比较快;在QQ = 1\lambda=1时,例如,全参数型机在150个这样的提示音中的106个和33个更长的原型机上的答复音比较短. 在0.6B时,变化随着锚重的下降而增加. 在全参数训练下,4,7,11,和20个回复新未能以QQ = 1\lambda=1,0.1,0.01和0结束,而每次都是相反方向的2个回复;最后两个差异是显著的(p = 0.02 p = 0.002,p < 0.001 p < 0.001). 多数来自长式的Dolly提示,往往是无穷无尽的编号列表,如集思广益的答案. General的分数并没有揭示这个变化:没有锚的0.6B模型的普通平均1.0分比原作高,因为这些任务得分概率,提取最后的答案,或者只检查说明的指令.

blocks.en: The two scales favor different weights (Figure 4 ). At 0.6B, lighter anchors help decisions: λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 gives the best JevBench accuracy (59.7%; 9 wins and 3 losses against λ = 1 \lambda=1 ) and calibration (ECE 0.101), and λ ≤ 0.01 \lambda\leq 0.01 raises Banking77 significantly. This suggests that the weak 0.6B model has much to learn, so some departure from the original model helps. At 4B, the strongest anchor decides best: λ = 1 \lambda=1 gives the highest JevBench accuracy with both methods and, with full-parameter training, significantly higher Banking77 accuracy ( p < 0.02 p<0.02 against each lighter weight). This suggests that the 4B model already decides well and mainly needs the answer format, so departures from the original model add little. Lighter anchors do raise full-parameter 4B External accuracy by about one point ( p < 0.02 p<0.02 ), partly because λ = 1 \lambda=1 moves ten-option MMLU-Pro answers from option 10 to option 1, whose identifiers share their first token (Appendix H ). In chat, λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 changes the full-parameter 0.6B model’s behavior only slightly and not significantly, while λ = 1 \lambda=1 keeps it closest to the original.
blocks.zh: 两个鳞片偏爱不同的重量(图4). 在0.6B时,较轻的锚能帮助决定:QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1给出最佳的Jev Bench精度(59.7%;9胜3败对QQ=1\lambda=1)和校准(ECE 0.101),QQ0.01\lambda\leq0.01大幅提升Bank77. 这表明弱0.6B模型有很多东西需要学习,因此一些与原模型的偏离有帮助. 在4B时,最强锚最能决定:QQ = 1\lambda=1给出两种方法中最高的Jev Bench精度,经过全参数训练,银行77精度显著提高(p < 0.02 p < 0.02对每轻重量). 这表明4B模型已经做出了很好的决定,并且主要需要答案格式,因此与原始模型的偏离增加的很少. 较轻的锚点确实将全参数 4B 外部精度提高约1点(p < 0.02 p < 0.02),部分原因是QQ = 1\lambda=1 将十个选项的 MMLU-Pro 答案从选项 10 移动到选项 1,其标识符共享其第一个符号(附录 H). 在聊天中,QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1只改变全参数的0.6B模型的行为,而QQ=1\lambda=1保持与原样最接近.

blocks.en: LoRA with λ = 1 \lambda=1 reaches 84.0% on JevBench, the best 4B model we trained (13 wins, 7 losses against the training-free model), and all four LoRA runs exceed the training-free baseline (81.8–84.0%). LoRA beats full-parameter training by 2.2–3.5 points at every anchor weight, significantly at λ = 1 \lambda=1 ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 ) and λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ), and LoRA with λ = 1 \lambda=1 beats every full-parameter run ( p ≤ 0.04 p\leq 0.04 ). It also has the best JevBench Brier score (0.238, vs. 0.247 for the original) and matches the lighter-anchor full-parameter runs on External (79.2%); at the same weight, it trails full-parameter training only on Banking77 (74.2% vs. 75.9%). Its General average (67.2% vs. 67.3%), text mode, and chat behavior are unchanged: it changes only 55 of the 1,250 General items.
blocks.zh: LORA与QQ=1\lambda=1在Jev Bench上达到84.0%,是我们所训练的最佳4B模式(13胜7负于无训练模式),所有四个LORA运行都超过了无训练基线(81.8-84.0%). LORA在每根锚重量上以2.2–3.5分击败全参数训练,显著的为QQ=1\lambda=1(p=0.04 p=0.04)和0.01\lambda=0.01(p=0.02 p=0.02),LORA与QQ=1\lambda=1击败每条全参数跑(p=0.04 p=leq 0.04). 它还有最佳的Jev Bench Brier分数(0.238对0.247对原作),并匹配Outter上的较轻的瞄准器全参数运行(79.2%);同样重量,它只跟踪银行77(74.2%对75.9%)的全参数训练. 其通用平均值(67.2%对67.3%),文本模式,聊天行为不变:在1,250个普通项目中,它只改变55个.

blocks.en: At every anchor weight, LoRA and full-parameter training are within three JevBench items of each other. LoRA is slightly lower on External at λ ≤ 0.01 \lambda\leq 0.01 , and both methods lose some IFEval accuracy (LoRA 4.0–6.5 points, full-parameter training 3.0–6.0). A higher learning rate ( 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} ) fits the training data better than full-parameter training (development tree loss 0.815 vs. 0.835) but does not raise JevBench or External accuracy (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 每一锚重量,LORA和全参数训练都在彼此的三个Jev Bench项之内. LoRA在Outlook 0.01\lambda\leq 0.01上略低,两种方法都失去了一些IFEval精度(LORA 4.0–6.5分,全参数训练3.0–6.0. 高等教育率(3×10−4 3\time 10×4})比全参数培训更适合培训数据(开发树损失0.815对0.835),但不会提高Jev Bench或外部准确度(表13)。

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient training might be expected to protect the original model on its own, but it does not. Without anchors, 9 of the 4B LoRA model’s text-mode answers fail to parse, mostly because the option label follows the identifier, and 108 of the 0.6B LoRA model’s answers reach the 32-token limit. In chat, 0.6B LoRA drifts more than full-parameter training at every weight below 1: 12, 22, and 38 replies newly fail to end at λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , 0.01, and 0, compared with 7, 11, and 20.
blocks.zh: 参数效率培训可以预期能够单独保护原型号,但并不如此。 没有主锚,4B LoRA模型的文本模式答案中有9个无法解析,这主要是因为选项标签遵循标识符,0.6B LoRA模型的答案中有108个达到了32个键的极限. 在聊天中,0.6B LORA在1:12,22以下的每个重量下漂移超过全参数训练,38个答复新未能结束,分别为QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1,0.01和0,而分别为7,11和20.

blocks.en: MMLU-Pro is the only ranked External benchmark with two-digit identifiers: 658 of its 800 questions have ten options, and the suffixes of options 1 and 10 share their first token. Training shifts answers away from option 10, more so at larger anchor weights. With full-parameter training, the 4B model picks option 10 on 45 of these questions before training and on 31, 26, 21, and 19 at λ = 0 \lambda=0 , 0.01, 0.1, and 1; the 0.6B model does so on 18 before training and on 16, 13, 5, and 2. At 4B with λ = 1 \lambda=1 , the displaced answers go to option 1 (178 picks vs. 123), and 15 of the model’s 17 net MMLU-Pro losses occur on these questions. We have not identified the cause.
blocks.zh: MMLU-Pro是唯一排名为2位数的外部基准识别符:其800个问题中有658个有10个选项,选项1和10的后缀共享了他们的第一個符號. 训练的改变与选择10不同,在更大的锚重方面更是如此。 在全参数训练下,4B型在训练前在45个问题上选择选项10,在31、26、21和19上选择=0\lambda=0、0.01、0.1和1;0.6B型在训练前18和16、13、5和2上选择选项10。 在4B和QQ=1\lambda=1时,流离失所的答案转到备选案文1(178个选择对123个选择),模型的17个净MMLU-Pro损失中有15个发生在这些问题上。 我们没有查明原因。
